item.title: A roadmap of the claimed Lean proof of the Riemann hypothesis
item.description: A reading guide to the 175,000-file Lean development released on 20 November 2026 that claims RH and GRH for Dirichlet L-functions: what is standard, what carries the argument, where to look first, and a plan for human readers.
